Bond depreciation kills sybil value at its nadir. Each identity buys a 120-unit bond losing 4% per epoch. Only verified work restores value, so a harbor of idle bonds shrinks.

The kernel rule is simple. Bonds lock 10 epochs. Real work adds 4 units back each epoch. Below 60 units, rewards fall to zero.

One fake costs 120 units. After 10 idle epochs it is 72. Forgery slashes 50%. Building 1,000 fakes locks 120,000 units and bleeds 4,800 per epoch.
